_doc: The application evaluator runs each case as a baseline/no-skill arm and a with-skill arm, then grades behavior against expected_flags, expected_fix_hints, absent_signals, and the per-case criteria checklist.
subject: Declaring, measuring, and enforcing performance thresholds as a quality contract rather than an aspirational target —…

cases.scenario: A user asks: "set a Core Web Vitals budget for a marketing landing page and enforce it in CI"
cases.context: The agent has access to the performance-budgets skill and must decide whether to use it, apply its procedure, and stay inside its boundaries.
cases.question: What should the agent do, and why is performance-budgets the right skill to apply?
expected_flags: Recognizes performance-budgets as applicable to this request
Uses the skill-specific purpose or mental model instead of generic advice
Names the relevant boundary against rendering-models, http-semantics, performance-engineering
Turns the request into concrete steps, checks, or decisions from the skill
expected_fix_hints: Apply the performance-budgets workflow to the concrete scenario
State the next action and the evidence or verification needed
